description: Nonprofit and social-impact listings from Idealist: jobs (default), internships or volunteer roles for a keyword, optionally by country or remote only. Each listing: title, organisation and type, city, state, country, onsite/remote/hybrid, job type, salary range (min, max, currency, period) when posted, professional level, education, published date, coordinates and URL; plus the total number of matches. Newest first or by relevance. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Optional 2-letter country code, e.g. US, GB, CA

q.description: Keyword, e.g. data, program manager, fundraising (optional)
